The '''battle of Yrrna''' was an attack on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cargo area in the [[Yrrna system/Legends|Yrrna system]].

==Prelude==
After [[Ambush on Hashim|stealing]] a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototype from the Imperials and, with the help of Rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]], [[Battle of Kiilimaar|abduct]] the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief Scientist]] of the TIE Defender project. The [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]], had managed to gain the ability to manufacture and produce her own TIE Defenders. She decided to proliferate the technology against the Empire and arranged a demonstration to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by launching TIE Defenders against a cargo area in the Yrrna system.

[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] the Empire's best pilot was dispatched to investigate the area.

==The battle==
{{Quote|We're no match for those TIE Defenders. Let's get out of here!|A TIE Avenger pilot|audio=TDNoMatch-TF.flac|<ref name="TF:DE" />}}
Stele arrived with his wingman to find the surviving personnel had managed to board a [[Modular conveyor]] ''[[Ulzepdi]]'' and managed to escape the carnage, but were being pursued by Tarrak's forces in an attempt to allow no survivors. Stele engaged the first squad of [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from [[Gotmilc Squadron]], but his wingman developed "problems" that were brief. Then 4 [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]] ''[[Lucthz]]'' were the next group of enemies that Stele and his wingman destroyed to defend the conveyor. Lastly, two more squads of T-wings [[Gotan Squadron]] and [[Notow Squadron]] engaged Stele and his wingman but were both destroyed. The Conveyor reached a safe distance and escaped the area into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. The TIE Defenders now finished with the cargo containers turned their attention to Stele and his wingman, who decided it was best to pull out as they were outclassed and outnumbered, encouraged Stele to do the same.

==Aftermath==
The attack was everything the Empire feared. They now knew of Ali Tarrak's intentions through the crew and personnel on the ''Ulzepdi''. Fortunately [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] had developed a new starfighter, the [[Missile Boat]], to counter this serious threat and informed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of its completion. Palpatine promised that Thrawn will be well rewarded if these starfighters proved themselves by eliminating Zaarin. Thrawn wasted no time in putting the Missile Boats to the test.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' as the third mission in the battle [[New Threats]].
